notes.subject: ni
notes.rationale: נפש again 'life-force/throat', rendered 'ni', not 'soul' as a separable part

notes.subject: wuli
notes.rationale: נשא נפש 'to lift the soul' = to direct one's whole being toward; 'wuli' (lift) keeps the body picture

notes.subject: נפש...נפשי
notes.rationale: the verse brackets itself with נפש — servant's life made glad, my life lifted — a frame the Bambara 'ni...ni' keeps

notes.subject: to Adonay
notes.rationale: petition continues in direct second-person address

translation: Diya di i ka balla-ni ma, sabu ne bɛ ne ni wuli k'i la, Adonay.
